summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release and an updated investor presentation. No special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly update for a foreign private issuer. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is triggered. The 6-K is a standard earnings and business update with no material corporate action warranting classification under any special-situations category.
